page.overview:
Who is Ignazio Giunti?

Ignazio Giunti (August 30 1941 - January 10 1971) was an Italian driver. He made his debut with in , driving for them in both Formula 1 and endurance races.

He was killed at the 1971 1000 km of Buenos Aires, when he collided with the disabled car of Jean-Pierre Beltoise. Beltoise was pushing the car across the track when Giunti rounded the corner and was unable to avoid a collision.
